entries.note: Pseudo-star 'Vô chính diệu'. The book states these rules for any empty palace; emitted for Mệnh (builder may extend). Worked example of the rule 'read an empty palace by its opposite chính tinh: good if good, bad if bad'. The paired example (Thái Dương at Ngọ) cannot occur with Tý empty (Thiên Lương is then at Tý), so it is not emitted.

entries.note: HS reproduces Thái Thứ Lang's list (Tử Vi Đẩu Số p.293) without rejecting it ('xin mô phỏng'). p.57-58: phú/quý cục need to stay clear of Tuần, Triệt, sát and bại tinh (not-Tuần/Triệt added; sát tinh not testable as a list), and need đắc-địa stars; Khoa Quyền Lộc hội họp makes them 'toàn mỹ'. Book lists it for 'Cung Mệnh hay Quan' — also applies to Quan Lộc. As printed the condition names Tham Vũ, though the cục name says Tham Hỏa — encoded as printed; reviewer should check. p.58: an exception that keeps its value even with khắc tinh, so no Tuần/Triệt exclusion. Tham Vũ đồng cung only occurs at Sửu/Mùi.
